name: Super Strawberry Clock
storyline: Strawberry's friends have been kidnapped! You must save them!
summary: Super Strawberry Clock is a platform game where you play as Strawberry Clock and you try to get through the levels. There are 15 story mode levels and 10 challenge levels. The challenge levels were made by members of the Clockcrew with the level editor. This game has a level editor, by the way, where you can make your own levels and generate level codes and share them with friends. There is also an unlockable character and an unlockable bonus game. Also, this game is pretty hard.
